image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), perched on a rough tree branch. The bird displays characteristic breeding male plumage with a black head, bright orange-rufous breast and flanks, white belly, and black back with white shoulder patches. The background is a soft-focus bokeh of blue sky and branches.
